decision_clause: Ruled out: “JSON files on disk”; reason: “SQLite keeps each artifact atomically constrained with its correction lineage.” The decision is active and scoped to gitseed/storage.py and tests/test_storage.py.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The read APIs query the existing SQLite tables. When bounded, they select the latest rows using a descending SQLite LIMIT subquery and then restore chronological order; unbounded calls retain full append order. No JSON files are created or used as the run store.
rationale: Within the recorded scope, the implementation extends SQLite-backed reads and tests them against a persisted SQLite database. Although artifact payloads are serialized bytes, they remain rows in the constrained SQLite store with correction references; the implementation does not adopt the ruled-out JSON-files-on-disk storage approach.
